name: elaine-local-assistant
description: A local-first chat assistant UI for OpenAI-compatible APIs, Ollama, and vLLM.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace client && npm run build --workspace server
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace client && npm run lint --workspace server && eslint .
